The one-line PubMed query is saved in [final_strategy.txt](/C:/Users/aaron/AppData/Local/Temp/psb-evals/run-37e3fa46fd7e2f7f/ours-codex-noseed-20260927T141818Z/final_strategy.txt). The final search returned **5,260 records** with the publication-date cutoff of July 20, 2020.

I interpreted the question as finding environmental-health systematic reviews for methodological appraisal; rigor is assessed during screening. Relative recall was **7/7** in the development set and **3/3** in the held-out validation set. These are small, selected sets and do not estimate sensitivity. The two-round internal critique has no open must-fix findings.

The audit, scope assumptions, and critic records are in [work/audit.md](/C:/Users/aaron/AppData/Local/Temp/psb-evals/run-37e3fa46fd7e2f7f/ours-codex-noseed-20260927T141818Z/work/audit.md), [work/protocol.json](/C:/Users/aaron/AppData/Local/Temp/psb-evals/run-37e3fa46fd7e2f7f/ours-codex-noseed-20260927T141818Z/work/protocol.json), and `work/critic/`. This PubMed-only draft still needs PRESS peer review by an information specialist before use.
